description.p: A coding agent with a GPU-rendered UI and a headless core: long-term memory with a review inbox, worktree tabs, subagents, skills, MCP, and permission modes that keep every mutating action behind a card you approve.

The flatpak runs commands through your host environment, so your toolchains (rust, node, go, python) work as they do outside the sandbox; every action is gated by the permission mode you choose, and full access costs a confirmation card.
The first release: the whole contract, from the memory review inbox to the mode menu.
